'''''Koh-Lanta: L'Île au Trésor''''' ({{translation|Koh-Lanta: Island of Treasure}}) was the sixteenth season of the French version of [[Survivor (franchise)|''Survivor'']], ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. The main twist this season is that there is an island separated from the two tribes known as Treasure Island. On the island is a buried chest which contains the Golden Ring, an item which secures the owner a spot in the final five. In order to open the chest, the contestants must find ten metallic pieces, each of which points to the next marker. Once all ten pieces are found, the chest can be opened.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.telestar.fr/tele-realite/koh-lanta/ile-au-tresor/koh-lanta-l-ile-au-tresor-qui-des-20-candidats-a-le-plus-de-chance-de-gagner-229719|title=Koh Lanta, l'île au trésor : Qui des 20 candidats a le pl... - Télé Star|date=26 August 2016}}</ref>

The season premiered on 26 August 2016<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ozap.com/actu/-koh-lanta-l-ile-au-tresor-des-le-26-aout-sur-tf1/504240|title="Koh-Lanta : l'Île au trésor" dès ce soir sur TF1|date=26 August 2016 }}</ref> and concluded on 9 December when Benoît Assadi was crowned the title of Sole Survivor in a unanimous 10-0 jury vote against Jesta Hillmann.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/medias/television/koh-lanta-le-breton-benoit-assadi-remporte-l-emission-de-tf1-4668866 | title=Koh Lanta. Le Breton Benoît Assadi remporte l'émission de TF1 | date=8 December 2016 }}</ref>

== Challenges ==

==Future appearances==
Candice Boisson, Jérémy Raffin and Julie Navarro-Camilleri later returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Combat des Héros]]''. Boisson returned for a third time for ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Légende]]''.

==Future appearances (Fort Boyard)==
Candice Boisson and Jérémy Raffin later returned for [[Fort Boyard (game show)|Fort Boyard]] 2019.
